# Benchmark (generated by `scripts/benchmark.py`)

Provider: `csv` (bundled sample, data ends 2017-11-10) · horizon: 5 trading days · history: 10Y · walk-forward, refit every 25 days, up to 250 out-of-sample forecasts.

MAE is in price units, so compare models **within** a ticker, not across tickers. `vs persist.` / `vs drift` = MAE reduction relative to those baselines (positive = better). A model has demonstrated edge only if it clearly beats both.

## AAPL  (250 out-of-sample forecasts, 18s)

| Rank | Model | MAE | RMSE | R² (price) | Dir. acc. | vs persist. | vs drift | Edge? |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Support Vector Regression | 2.637 | 3.559 | 0.9562 | 62.8% | +7.2% | +2.2% | yes |
| 2 | Random Forest | 2.637 | 3.588 | 0.9555 | 66.0% | +7.2% | +2.2% | yes |
| 3 | Bayesian Ridge | 2.644 | 3.570 | 0.9560 | 67.6% | +6.9% | +1.9% | no |
| 4 | Gradient Boosting | 2.649 | 3.602 | 0.9552 | 62.0% | +6.8% | +1.8% | no |
| 5 | K-Nearest Neighbors | 2.674 | 3.638 | 0.9543 | 59.6% | +5.9% | +0.8% | no |
| 6 | Baseline: Historical Drift | 2.696 | 3.638 | 0.9543 | 67.6% | +5.1% | +0.0% | baseline |
| 7 | Baseline: Persistence | 2.841 | 3.773 | 0.9508 | — | +0.0% | -5.4% | baseline |
| 8 | Decision Tree | 2.871 | 3.806 | 0.9500 | 52.0% | -1.1% | -6.5% | no |
| 9 | Baseline: Return to 20-day MA | 5.252 | 6.424 | 0.8574 | 40.4% | -84.9% | -94.8% | baseline |

_Best ML model by MAE: Support Vector Regression. Models beating BOTH the persistence and historical-drift baselines by more than 2% MAE: Support Vector Regression, Random Forest. Historical backtest only - not a guarantee._

## FB  (250 out-of-sample forecasts, 13s)

| Rank | Model | MAE | RMSE | R² (price) | Dir. acc. | vs persist. | vs drift | Edge? |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Bayesian Ridge | 2.675 | 3.392 | 0.9685 | 62.8% | +5.4% | +0.4% | no |
| 2 | Baseline: Historical Drift | 2.685 | 3.424 | 0.9679 | 62.8% | +5.0% | +0.0% | baseline |
| 3 | Decision Tree | 2.751 | 3.476 | 0.9669 | 62.0% | +2.7% | -2.4% | no |
| 4 | Random Forest | 2.764 | 3.497 | 0.9665 | 60.8% | +2.3% | -2.9% | no |
| 5 | K-Nearest Neighbors | 2.793 | 3.539 | 0.9657 | 58.0% | +1.2% | -4.0% | no |

| 7 | Baseline: Persistence | 2.828 | 3.607 | 0.9644 | — | +0.0% | -5.3% | baseline |
| 8 | Support Vector Regression | 2.913 | 3.627 | 0.9640 | 55.6% | -3.0% | -8.5% | no |
| 9 | Baseline: Return to 20-day MA | 4.366 | 5.508 | 0.9169 | 51.6% | -54.4% | -62.6% | baseline |

_Best ML model by MAE: Bayesian Ridge, but no ML model clearly beat both naive baselines (persistence and historical drift) - common for daily price data. A high R-squared on prices is not evidence of skill._
